name: Street Light Trend: Slide Into the Close-Up Under the Lamp
blurb: The street light trend, also called the AI Slide Transition Effect, is a short night clip: an empty path under a bright street light, a small figure far away that slides along the ground, and then the same person sliding into a close-up right in front of the camera.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 5 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: the same empty paved path at night with a striped curb, the same slim tree wrapped in small fairy lights beside a tall lamp post, the same bright white street light glowing at the top of the frame, dry grass and a long row of street lights fading into the distance, the same fixed phone camera at chest height, the same framing, timing and moves. The ONLY change: the young woman with long dark hair in the black off-shoulder top is now the person in [Image 1].

The main person = the person in [Image 1], in EVERY frame: copy the exact face from [Image 1]: face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles exactly as in the photo. They wear the clothes from [Image 1]; if [Image 1] shows only the head or the upper body, invent the rest so it matches naturally. The same real person in every frame, from the small figure far away by the tree to the close-up, so their friends instantly recognize them. Never morph, never drift back to the original woman's face, never add or remove facial hair. NO long dark hair and NO black off-shoulder top unless [Image 1] shows them, and the age of [Image 1]. If [Image 1] shows an animal, the main person is that animal, with its own face, fur and markings and the natural body volume and proportions of that animal: never flattened, squashed, stretched or merged with anything.

THE SHOTS, matching [Video 1] second by second:
00:00-00:01.4: the wide night shot. Far away by the tree and the lamp post, the main person, small in the frame, finishes a low playful slide along the ground and leaves the frame. The path stays empty for a beat.
00:01.4-00:02: the main person slides into the frame from the lower left, very close to the lens, the hair swinging with the motion.
00:02-00:05.3: a close-up from the chest up right in front of the camera, centered under the street light, the face lit by the cool white lamp, a calm, confident look straight into the lens, small head tilts and a slight sway, the hair moving softly. The tree with its fairy lights and the glowing lamp stay behind the head.

Real live-action phone footage at night, clear facial features, natural skin, no distortion.

Avoid: text, captions, subtitles, logos, watermarks, app buttons, extra people, extra limbs, morphing, facial distortion.

Anatomy rules: one head only, on the person's shoulders. Two arms and two hands, five fingers on each hand. Exactly one person in the video, also in the wide shot.
